notes.title: PPO Development Update #2
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I wanted to give you a quick update about a live stream happening today. This stream will showcase new features that have been developed for the game. You can watch it live or later by clicking on this link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2seF9Zw2Deg&ab_channel=Vitali.

During the stream, I'll be discussing exciting new additions to the game, such as water, swimming, and diving. You can also participate in testing these new features by using the test server which will be available during the stream.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44670231/0276116512c6e37b155fecdf02b2b89f66462a56.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44670231/0276116512c6e37b155fecdf02b2b89f66462a56.gif[/img][/url]

To stay up-to-date with future game tests, you can visit this link: https://pixelpiracy.net/.


Thank you and have a great time watching the stream!

notes.title: PPO Development Update #1
notes.content:
Hey folks!

The year is ending, and I wanted to do a update and wish everyone a happy upcoming year.

There will be a PPO Stream #2 this Friday, which is pretty soon, so if you want to see the latest developments, join the live stream. Here is the link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WARZ2d6WNTw&ab_channel=Vitali 

For those who can't join but want to know what's up, the TDLR is the significant achievement for this dev cycle is: the UI Form System and Paperdoll system that allows 14 different equips, different weapon types, such as melee, knuckles, and 2H Weapons. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5379466/2588df5f6cc74966e8cb72f29633a74092b389a5.gif[/img]
[I]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5379466/5c71726cec1f00b1f6913350d84330de1b53915f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5379466/136dcaf159b3b22cd31bd71ec5c4513254625b95.gif[/img]

"Do note ART is not final, and everything is WIP; in 2023+, the name of the game is that you must put a Steam store page for game projects as soon as possible if you want to have any chance of success and build community, MMO's are tech-heavy games so demonstration of working tech is more important than good art/concept art."[/i]

Next, I plan to begin work on the ship system; it's the most piratey thing possible and going to take some time— it's a pretty big system, and when it comes to PPO, it has to surpass PP in almost everything.

I hope you found this post insightful, and I hope to see some of you on the stream and again next year with the PPO Development Update #2.

Have a good one #piracyfam!

notes.title: Hello World!
notes.content:
Hello, Steam community!

I just wanted to say hello and introduce myself. My name is Vitali Kirpu, and I'm excited to be here, building the game for your enjoyment.

I have been pretty busy with this game.

I thought I'd start with the classic "Hello World" message for my first post. It's a simple but powerful statement that's been used to introduce beginners to programming for decades; it works well for posts like these, too.

So, without further ado:

Hello, World!
